care.summary: Popular epiphytic cactus with segmented flat stems and vibrant winter blooms; easy to care for with proper light and watering.
care.light: Bright indirect light; avoid direct afternoon sun
care.water: Keep soil evenly moist during growing season; reduce watering after blooming
care.soil: Well-draining, slightly acidic potting mix; orchid bark or cactus mix with perlite
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer monthly during spring and summer; stop feeding in fall
care.toxicity: Non-toxic to cats, dogs, and humans
common_issues: Root rot from overwatering or poor drainage
Bud drop from temperature fluctuations, drafts, or moving plant while budding
Mealybugs and spider mites on indoor plants
tips: Needs 12-14 hours of complete darkness daily for 6-8 weeks to trigger blooming
Allow soil to dry slightly between waterings in winter dormancy
Avoid moving the plant once buds form to prevent bud drop
Prune after flowering to encourage branching
